title: Cancer overdiagnosis: a biological challenge and clinical dilemma

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Cancer overdiagnosis: a biological challenge and clinical dilemma》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】For cancer screening to be successful, it should primarily detect cancers with lethal potential or their precursors early, leading to therapy that reduces mortality and morbidity.

evidence.text: For cancer screening to be successful, it should primarily detect cancers with lethal potential or their precursors early, leading to therapy that reduces mortality and morbidity.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Cancer overdiagnosis: a biological challenge and clinical dilemma》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-9】In this Opinion article, we focus on the contribution of screening in general and high-risk populations to overdiagnosis, the effects of overdiagnosis on patients and emerging strategies to reduce overdiagnosis of indolent cancers through an understanding of tumour heterogeneity, the biology of how cancers evolve and progress, the molecular and cellular features of early neoplasia and the dynamics of the interactions of early lesions with their surrounding tissue microenvironment.
